$comment: Seasons that have been exported to archive files, with their checksums.
The archives themselves are deliberately absent from this repository and are not published
anywhere. They are collected data needed only where the site is deployed, they weigh about 1 MB
each, and they are not ours to redistribute. This file records what was built so a checksum can
be verified after moving an archive to a deployment.
Build them with scripts/build-seasons.ps1 after backfilling the season. Checksums change on
every rebuild, because each export records the time it was taken.
